newsitem.title: HONG KONG: S&P rates Panda Global Energy snr notes at B-minus.
newsitem.headline: S&P rates Panda Global Energy snr notes at B-minus.

text.p: Standard & Poor's said on Friday it rated Panda Global Energy Co's US$150 million senior secured notes due 2004 at B-minus.

The notes are to be repaid from partnership distributions paid to affiliates of Panda Global which have interests in three cogeneration projects. Repayment relies mainly on a coal-fired project in China's Luannan County, S&P said.
It said cash flow also derived to a lesser extent from two natural gas-fired projects in the United States.
Only 20 percent of the notes will be amortized by the time they are due. Repayment of senior notes relies on the company's ability to refinance the oustanding principal when due.

The other risks include a highly leveraged financing structure, the rating agency said. Panda Global's holding company debt to capitalization is expected to be 101 percent. If the operations of the three projects were consolidated, the figure would be 122 percent.
The risks were lessened in part by great demand in the area for electricity, S&P said.
It said less than 10 percent of the county's peak demand is being met by the North China Power's Beijing-Tianjin-Tangshan grid.
S&P said the outlook was stable although the possibility of Chinese central government intervention in the joint venture posed a risk to the Luannan project.
